base: Unretouched editorial photograph by a documentary photographer, indistinguishable from a real photo. Shot on a Canon EOS R5, 35mm f/1.4, ISO 3200, 1/80 s: natural noise, slight softness, a little motion blur on moving hands, warm tungsten light mixed with cool window light, slightly underexposed shadows, muted true-to-life colours, no HDR, no glow, no retouching. Ordinary Brazilian people, not models: real skin with pores and blemishes, flyaway hair, everyday clothes with creases. Candid, nobody looks at the camera, imperfect framing with foreground objects. A busy, lived-in Brazilian neighbourhood restaurant in Fortaleza at night: worn wooden tables, beer bottles, glasses, napkins, plates with leftovers, chalkboard menu. No QR codes, no table cards, no logos, no text overlays, no watermark.

dono-fechando-caixa.texto: Late night after closing, a tired Brazilian restaurant owner in his 50s, grey stubble, sits at the counter with paper receipts, a calculator and card-machine slips spread out, rubbing his eyes. Chairs upside down on tables behind him, one warm light on.

dona-salao-cheio.texto: A Brazilian restaurant owner in her 40s, curly hair tied up, black apron over a linen shirt, stands near the bar watching a completely full dining room on a Friday night, arms crossed, a proud but alert expression. Waiters moving in motion blur.

fila-caixa.texto: A queue of five customers standing at a small cashier counter near the door of a busy restaurant, waiting to pay, one checking his watch, another holding a toddler. The cashier is typing on an old register. Seen from the side.

mesa-vazia-pratos.texto: A table where the meal has clearly ended: empty plates, crumpled napkins, beer bottles, nobody eating anymore, four friends leaning back chatting and looking around for the waiter. Medium shot, warm light.

garcom-correndo.texto: A young Brazilian waiter walking fast between crowded tables carrying three plates on one arm and a card machine in his back pocket, motion blur on legs, several customers in the background raising hands.

garconete-sorrindo.texto: A Brazilian waitress in her 20s with braided hair and a black apron laughs while chatting with a table of customers, relaxed, holding a notepad, nobody is waiting for anything. Candid, warm evening light.

familia-domingo-almoco.texto: Sunday lunch in a simple seafood restaurant in Fortaleza near the beach, a big Brazilian family of three generations at a long table full of fish, rice and baião de dois, grandmother laughing, kids with juice glasses.

amigos-barraca-praia.texto: Late afternoon at a beach kiosk (barraca) in Praia do Futuro, Fortaleza: four friends at a plastic table under a umbrella, coconut water and beer, crab plates, sea and sunset behind them, one holding a phone and smiling at the screen.

chef-cozinha-pedidos.texto: Inside a hot, busy restaurant kitchen, a Brazilian cook in his 30s with a bandana reads order tickets hanging on a rail while flames rise from a pan, a second cook plating behind him, steam and stainless steel.

maos-celular-mesa.texto: Close-up of a woman's hands holding a smartphone above a restaurant table at the end of a meal, thumb about to tap the screen, which shows a simple clean white payment screen with a big green button; blurred plates and glasses around. The screen has no brand logo.

bar-balcao-noite.texto: Night at a lively Fortaleza bar counter: a bartender pours a caipirinha, customers on stools laughing, fairy lights, bottles on shelves, warm orange light and deep shadows.

dono-celular-sorrindo.texto: A Brazilian restaurant owner in his 30s in a simple black t-shirt stands by the kitchen pass during service, glancing at his phone with a small satisfied smile, the busy dining room softly blurred behind him.
